ops.body: Claimed by the stabilization session (local, 2026-07-25). Plan: move Store.Remove off the settlement-critical path in worker/pool.go, fix the 10ms settlementPollInterval flock'd-store polling, add both acceptance-criteria tests. The release containing this fix becomes the frozen fleet baseline; daemonkit releases freeze after it until all downstreams repin and go green. See the coordination note "Fleet stabilization plan active".
